audience: fleet operators and dispatchers who track vehicles, drivers and trips in Quartix

useCases.title: See where vehicles and drivers are now
useCases.text: Get the latest position, speed and last event of each vehicle or driver. The data is live and is not cached.

useCases.title: Review vehicle trips for a period
useCases.text: List the trips of vehicles in a period, with distance and idling time, and get a trip summary per vehicle.

useCases.title: Compare driver trip summaries
useCases.text: Get distance, travel time, idling time and trip count per driver for a period. The results contain personal data.

useCases.title: Find vehicles by site or group
useCases.text: List the regions, sites and groups of the account, then list the vehicles with their group membership.
